content.title: How to Become a Mortgage Loan Officer in 2025! (Step by Step)
content.text: So you want to be a Loan Officer? Watch this video and find out if its right for you! This is one of the easiest licenses to get, with such high earning potential, and it can be remote! That is why I think this is one of the best side hustles or careers for anyone to do. OnCourse Mortgage: https://partners.oncourselearning.com... ^Get 15% off using my exclusive OnCourse link! This is the exact program I took to earn my loan license, and I highly recommend it—it’s the most affordable course out there. Plus, I managed to get the highest discount code for my viewers, so if you use my link above, you’ll receive 15% off the MLO course. Make sure to watch this video until the end for tips on becoming a mortgage loan officer in the easiest and fastest way. I went through this process myself, passed the exam on my first try, and want to help you succeed too! Each state has slightly different requirements, but generally, it’s about a 20-hour course. Here in California, all I needed to do was complete the 20-hour online course and follow the easy steps shared in this video. It’s surprisingly simple, and I still can’t believe how straightforward the process is to become licensed to offer loans. We'll go through the following: Qualities of a successful loan officer What is a mortgage loan originator?
